content:
alex: FYI support flagged a weird pattern: leads briefly claimed, then immediately released and requeued. looks like ownership flapping during enrichment + SF upsert dedupe. :grimacing:
mei: saw that in logs this morning. dedupe id changes mid-write and RR thinks lead is free. we get two claim attempts in <2s and one loses lease.
jon: can we debounce ownership transitions? e.g., once claimed, mark claim_protected_until = now + 30s so RR ignores it even if dedupe changes.
ops-bot: incident created INC-2026: ownership-flap-highrate, alerted 1:07AM PT
mei: debouncing sounds reasonable. also add a lightweight watermark: last_claim_attempt_ts and owner_session_id so we can detect rapid churn and auto-suppress reclaims for N seconds.
carla: sales noticed some leads never reached SDRs during the flap window. we need short-term mitigation that doesn't require SF schema changes.
alex: proposal for quick roll: 1) RR honor claim_protected_until TTL (default 30s) 2) backstop job that only picks leads with last_claim_attempt_ts older than 45s 3) add metric ownership_flap_rate and a grafana panel.
jon: also consider a per-owner soft quota so one noisy integration can't cycle many leads. per-owner throttle 50 claims/minute.
mei: Agree on quotas. For the debounce setting, make it configurable by account. some high-throughput accounts may need 5s instead of 30s.
carla: timeline? we need something before next campaign Thursday. can we canary today?
alex: eng can ship config flip to RR and backstop in canary in 4-6h. metrics + alert in parallel.
jon: I'll add tests to simulate dedupe-ID flip and ensure RR respects claim_protected_until. also add a check to avoid race with enrichment writes: enrichment sets in_progress=true on start, RR will skip any lead with that flag.
mei: good. small runbook note: if ownership_flap_rate > 1% for 10m, flip protection TTL up and pause new campaign imports.
carla: pls ping ops when canary starts, ops will stand by to re-route priority leads to manual queue if needed.
alex: action items: jon implement TTL honor + tests, mei implement watermark/metric, carla coordinate sales/ops and prepare manual queue, alex run canary and post updates. canary target: accounts 42 and 73 only.
ops-bot: scheduled canary job at 11:30AM PT. participants notified. :white_check_mark:
